summary: Frontend-only verification of 3 iteration-5 fixes + quick regression. All PASS. Regenerate changes seat assignments on every click (3/3, 14 students). Dragged table position (3%,14% -> 12.79%,21.95%) persists after Save room layout + teacher desk toggle (both directions). Group Maker (14 students, size 4): moving members creates uneven sizes -> score drops 86->81->76 and summary 'Uneven group sizes'; emptying group 1 removes it (4 -> 3 groups). Regression: saved plan save/load restores seats, copy 2 students from class A and paste into class B works ('Pasted 2 students.'), testimonials auto-rotate.
